mentions.name: Fuguux
mentions.description: This platform provides AI user testing: given a website and a task (e.g. "Add a pink shirt to the shopping cart"), AI users attempt the task, and the output is a report with a prioritized list of identified usability problems plus narrated videos showing each AI user trying the site. It aims to make finding major usability issues dramatically faster and cheaper, complementing rather than replacing real user testing.
mentions.problem: Real usability testing is slow and expensive; this makes it possible to get quick feedback on potential usability problems in hours for a fraction of the cost, enabling faster iteration.
mentions.audience: Product managers and dev teams looking to find major usability issues with their websites quickly and cheaply.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're working on AI user testing, to make it dramatically faster and cheaper for product managers and dev teams to find major usability issues with web sites. Give us a web site and a task users would do (e.g. "Add a pink shirt to the shopping cart"), and we have some AI users try their best to do the task. The output is a report with a prioritized list of problems identified, plus narrated videos that show each AI user trying the site.
